a: An SLA is a service-level agreement defining uptime/latency targets and consequences.
An SLI is a service-level indicator — a measured metric like success rate or latency.
An SLO is a service-level objective — the target value for an SLI.
Error budget is the allowed unreliability derived from the SLO.
MTTR is mean time to repair; MTBF is mean time between failures.
Focus on systems and process failures, not personal blame, to improve reliability.
A runbook lists step-by-step actions for operating and recovering a system.
Automate repetitive operational work so engineers focus on engineering.
Rotate on-call duty fairly with clear handoffs and escalation paths.
A temporary pause on risky deploys during critical business periods.
